header: The pads' plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, played with its tools/gamepad_probe.js as the preload
(--preload): two stand-in pads plugged in at the launcher, before Start Game, as a player's pads are there when the
game starts, each playing a port of its own in the order it was plugged in (RECOMPINPUT_PADS_IN_ORDER, the
CMakeLists.txt). From the file menu tools/shader_survey.js opens the Combat Simulator's menu as the main menu's
Combat Simulator does (mpMenu), and the second pad's Start joins player 2 there, the game's own way: it needs both
players joined. The survey then starts a combat match on Skedar for them (mpStart), as the menu does once both are
ready, and the match plays in split screen, its two halves one above the other and each as wide as the window
(patches/widescreen.c), each with its radar: about 40 s of the game's time, player 1 walking and turning on the
keyboard and player 2 on its pad's left stick, each shot taken where only one of them has moved.
